name: Parameter 14
definition: Parameters associated to a cryptographic encryption algorithm.

EncryptionFormat.name: Encryption Format
EncryptionFormat.definition: Format of data before encryption, if the format is not plaintext or implicit.

InitialisationVector.name: Initialisation Vector
InitialisationVector.definition: Initialisation vector of a cipher block chaining (CBC) mode encryption.

BytePadding.name: Byte Padding
BytePadding.definition: Byte padding for a cypher block chaining mode encryption, if the padding is not implicit.
